subject: general
question: In a group of 108 persons, the ratio of the number of males and females is 5 : 4. The average height of the males is 158.7 cm and that of the females is x cm. If the average height of all the persons in the group is 155.5 cm, then the value of x is:
solution:
Given:

Total number of persons = 108

The ratio of the number of males and females is 5 : 4

The average height of the males is 158.7 cm and that of the females is x cm

The average height of all of them = 155.5 cm

Formula used:

Average weight = Sum of the weight/ No of students

Calculation:

Number of males = 108 × 5/9 = 60

Number of females = 108 × 4/9 = 48

Now,

155.5 × 108 = 158.7 × 60 + x × 48

⇒ 16794 = 9522 + 48x

⇒ 48x = 7272

⇒ x = 151.5

∴ The value of x is 151.5 kg
